text:
carmen: heads up, seeing a spike in Pending tiny pods in apse1-azb since ~03:05 UTC. Warm nodes entering cooldown and bind failures. packer shows fragmentation hotspots.
nate: same. warmpool attach errors repeating: `attach/detach: device not ready` and a bunch of `gpu: thermal_throttle` traces in node logs.
jeff: any infra pushes around that time? we rolled a microcode/firmware change late last night.
mina: noticed scheduler trying to spread tiny-worker across racks -> lots of evictions when those warm nodes cool down. cascade begins when warmpool nodes stop advertising capacity.
ops-bot: ALERT apse1-azb: warm-node-heartbeat-drop > 0.15 (10m)
sre-oncall: plan proposal — 1) apply rack-scoped warmpool bump (+2 cheaper instance types) 2) disable cross-az gangbackfill for small-worker for 40m 3) cordon the most-affected nodes to prevent thrash 4) monitor pack_frag_score and eviction_rate
carmen: +1. bump cost estimate ~ $180/hr for mitigation window — acceptable.
nate: to minimize blast radius, we'll label the rack: `kubectl label nodes -l rack=azb remediation=true` and patch autoscaler to pick nodes with that label.
mina: also suggest temporarily lowering `topologySpreadConstraints` priority for deployments with `tier=small-worker` via annotation so scheduler can pack them where capacity exists.
jeff: careful with spread relax — do per-deployment only. global change will mask other availability issues.
sre-oncall: executing cordon on node-azb-12 and draining non-critical pods now.
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-0311-azb-warmnode-fallback https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-0311-azb-warmnode-fallback
carmen: warmpool scaled and labels applied. seeing pack_frag_score drop from 0.81 -> 0.38 in ~5m.
nate: evictions fell from ~20/min -> 3/min. starting 1h watch then roll back.
mina: logging: will capture kernel/driver thermal events and attach to infra ticket; also add an alert rule to detect sudden warm-node heartbeat drops to auto-scale warmpool.
jeff: file a follow-up with firmware team; include fan curve diffs from the last rollout.
sre-oncall: mitigation complete, monitoring. will uncordon nodes once drivers cleared.
carmen: great work. we'll reconvene for RCA tomorrow. :thumbsup:
